name: Chemplast Sanmar Ltd
title: Chemplast Sanmar Ltd - 543336 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Suspension PVC (CCVL) hit by China carbide dumping and a ₹898 Cr investment impairment; spreads now at variable-cost breakeven, while specialty is the stated capital-allocation priority.

utilisation.quote: The Cuddalore Paste PVC facility operated through the year at 100% of capacity

capex.peers_comment: Management said Adani and Reliance will respond on their own PVC/CPVC capacity additions.
capex.quote: it's better that Reliance and Adani respond to this question

triggers.label: Spread at replacement-cost neutral
triggers.quote: we are looking at a spread which is at a neutral level on a replacement cost basis
triggers.highlight: spread which is at a neutral level

triggers.label: ADD on China PVC not yet granted
triggers.quote: none of these measures has come through. In fact, regulatory support has weakened

triggers.label: Impairment ₹898 Cr on CCVL investment
triggers.quote: The assessment has resulted in an impairment loss of INR898 crores

triggers.label: Paste PVC volumes +17% YoY
triggers.quote: Sales volumes also registered a healthy 17% year-on-year increase, mainly driven by paste PVC

triggers.label: R32 capacity 14 kt by year-end
